svg.aria-label: The objects of a run with the implicit static solver NIST. Nesting shows which object holds which; the fill shows how long an object lives: per job, per step, per numbering, per locations, per increment or per Newton iteration. The driver, finiteElementSimulation, holds the StepManager with the step actions, the current Step with its TimeStepper, the FEModel with nodes, node fields, elements and constraints, the output managers, the journal, and the solver. The solver holds its options (per job), its convergence criterion and its LinearSolver (per step), the multi-point-constraint condensation (per numbering), the SystemMatrixAssembly and the vectors U, dU, P (per locations, the values carried over), and its DiscreteSystem (per locations), which holds the DofLocations (per locations), which hold the DofNumbering (per numbering): the numbering outlives its holders. The LinearSolver holds the DOF layout of the model (per numbering) and its factorization (by default per iteration). The local variables of solveIncrement are R and U_np (per increment) and the condensed matrix K_ and the correction ddU (per iteration). Green: the creator, where it is not the holder: the StepManager creates each Step (generateSteps), the FEModel creates the DiscreteSystem (buildDiscreteSystem), the DiscreteSystem creates its successor (withNewLocations), and the DofLocations create the vectors (constructDofVector).
